title: AuditRecord (LLM-call)
description: Append-only audit record emitted on every LLM call (inference or embedding) by every agent and the simulation Controller. Spec 036 EXTENDS the existing audit shape (spec 014/030/032) with the bold rows from data-model.md §AuditRecord. R3 amend-loop (Sessions 3+4+5) ADDS the additive-nullable fields: operator_override_rationale, approval_workflow_state, approval_authority, downgrade_justification, retrieval_index_name, field_coordinator_offline_decision, conflict_group_id, precedence_tiebreak_applied. Discriminator: call_kind. Source of truth for retrieval+inference equivalence replay (SC-011), FR-RAG-NS-01..09 carve-out enforcement, FR-RAG-AG-02 amend-loop audit-shape extension, FR-RAG-COORD-01/02 conflict trace stitching, and FR-RAG-IDX-04a in-flight-query-atomicity replay. Migration strategy per Pass 2 Q-P2-01: additive, in-place, schema-on-read via existing `infra/scripts/migrate-audit-record-036.ps1` (Phase D2 task T082).

timestamp_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC. For offline-replayed entries (FR-RAG-LS-02 reconnect) MUST preserve original on-device timestamp.

chat_turn_index.description: Set for SimulationController chat turns; null otherwise.

call_kind.description: R-13. Discriminator. `embedding` calls have no prompt and no retrieved chunks.

prompt_sha.description: SHA-256 of the rendered prompt. Required iff call_kind == 'inference'. Replay invariant SC-011.

model_id.description: E.g. 'gpt-4o-mini', 'text-embedding-3-large'. Resolved from the deployment map at call time.

model_version.description: Model semver as reported by the Foundry deployment — captures drift-of-the-month.

deployment_alias.description: Foundry deployment name (the value side of AZURE_AI_PROJECT_DEPLOYMENTS map). Required for replay parity.

embedding_model_id.description: Required iff call_kind == 'embedding' OR rag_used == true. Used to verify retrieval was issued against the alias-active index.

corpus_build_sha.description: Required iff rag_used == true. Pins replay to a specific corpus build.

retrieved_chunks.description: Required iff rag_used == true and non-empty. Empty array forbidden when rag_used == true (FR-RAG-AG-05 — no chunks → no grounding claim).

citations.description: Required iff rag_used == true. Each element MUST conform to citation-envelope.json. Every citation.sha256_of_chunk MUST also appear in retrieved_chunks[].sha256_of_chunk; mismatches increment hallucinated_citation_count and emit a separate `hallucinated_citation` event.

rag_used.description: false for FR-RAG-NS-01..09 paths and for call_kind == 'embedding'.

rag_optout_reason.description: Required iff rag_used == false AND call_kind == 'inference'. Maps 1:1 to FR-RAG-NS-01..09.

adr_pointer.description: Required iff rag_used == false. Points at the named ADR (FR-RAG-NS-08 lint enforces existence).

gateway_decision.description: Model gateway decision on the prompt + response (FR-RAG-CV-03). 'deny' aborts the call; 'redact' rewrites the payload.

hallucinated_citation_count.description: 0 for non-grounded paths; ≥0 for grounded. Above the R-10 threshold the agent downgrades confidence.

output_text_hash.description: SHA-256 of the model output text. Replay-comparable.

operator_actions.description: Downstream operator decisions: approval, edit, dismiss, escalate. Append-only; populated post-call.

operator_override_rationale.description: Spec-036 amend-loop NEW field (Cluster A5 / ADR-14). Captured when operator modifies or rejects the LLM recommendation. Nullable on legacy rows per the additive-in-place migration strategy (Pass 2 Q-P2-01).

approval_workflow_state.description: Spec-036 amend-loop NEW field (Cluster A5 / ADR-14). Tracks PIO/IC approval workflow for public-facing outputs (FR-RAG-LS-03). Nullable on legacy rows.

approval_authority.description: Spec-036 amend-loop NEW field (Cluster A5 / ADR-14). Identity (Entra ID) of the approving IC/PIO when approval_workflow_state transitions to approved or rejected. Required iff approval_workflow_state in (approved, rejected); null otherwise and on legacy rows.

downgrade_justification.description: Spec-036 amend-loop NEW field (Cluster A5 / ADR-14). Captured when IC downgrades the incident level. Nullable on legacy rows.

retrieval_index_name.description: Spec-036 amend-loop NEW field (Cluster A7 / ADR-16). Concrete AI Search index name (NOT the alias) resolved at query start by the retrieval client per FR-RAG-IDX-04a. Pinned for the entire query lifecycle to guarantee in-flight atomicity across blue-green alias flips. Required iff rag_used == true; null otherwise and on legacy rows.

field_coordinator_offline_decision.description: Spec-036 amend-loop NEW field (Cluster A5 / ADR-14). True when the decision was made by Field Coordinator while offline using cached doctrine (FR-RAG-LS-02 offline boundaries). Decisions tagged true MUST queue for IC review on reconnect with approval_workflow_state == 'pending'.

conflict_group_id.description: Spec-036 amend-loop NEW field (Cluster A9 / ADR-18). UUID v7 emitted by the multi-agent conflict detector (FR-RAG-COORD-01) when this AuditRecord is part of a conflicting recommendation pair/set. Foreign key to `conflictDetectionLog.conflict_group_id`. Null when no conflict; null on legacy rows.

precedence_tiebreak_applied.description: Spec-036 amend-loop NEW field (Cluster A1+A3 / ADR-13 / Pass 1 Q-P1-02). Trace of which deterministic tie-breakers were applied during precedence ranking when chunks shared `precedence_rank`. Empty array when no tie occurred; null on legacy rows. Recorded so SC-011 ≥95% byte-identical replay holds even when ranks tie.

tenant_id.description: Tenant isolation; matches the existing spec-029 tenant model.

correlation_id.description: Trace correlation across retrieval → inference → audit → SSE.

allOf.$comment: Invariant 1: rag_used == true → retrieved_chunks non-empty AND corpus_build_sha present AND embedding_model_id present.
Invariant 2: rag_used == false → rag_optout_reason AND adr_pointer required (for inference); retrieved_chunks empty.
Invariant 3: call_kind == 'embedding' → no prompt_sha, no retrieved_chunks, rag_used == false, embedding_model_id required.

Invariant 6 (R3 amend-loop ADR-16): rag_used == true → retrieval_index_name MUST be a concrete AI-Search index name (not the alias) so audit replay can pin to the exact index version even after the alias has flipped.
Invariant 7 (R3 amend-loop ADR-14): approval_workflow_state in (approved, rejected) → approval_authority required (Entra ID of the approving IC/PIO).
Invariant 8 (R3 amend-loop ADR-14): field_coordinator_offline_decision == true → approval_workflow_state MUST be 'pending' on emission so reconnect-time IC review is enforced.
